title: 🗝️ THE PADLOCK PARADOX 🗝️
paragraphs:
🗝️ THE PADLOCK PARADOX 🗝️
We pray, “God, open the doors for me…”
But the truth? 😅
Sometimes the doors are open — we just padlocked our hearts. 💔🔒

Maybe Heaven’s not ignoring you… maybe your heart’s on Do Not Disturb. 📵
Time to unlock, breathe, and let grace in. 💫

“Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in…”
— Revelation 3:20
💬 What’s the padlock on your heart today? Drop a 🔑 if you’re ready to unlock it.
